# ClawNet

> Universal AI agent orchestration layer — 344+ API endpoints, skill marketplace, x402 micropayments. Ask anything in natural language, get verified answers from 12,000+ data sources.

## Quick Start

- Base URL: https://api.claw-net.org
- Docs: https://claw-net.org/docs
- Dashboard: https://claw-net.org/dashboard
- Marketplace: https://claw-net.org/marketplace

## API Reference

- [Full llms.txt](https://api.claw-net.org/llms.txt): Complete endpoint reference with auth, pricing, skills
- [llms.txt with skills](https://api.claw-net.org/llms.txt/full): Includes all public skill listings
- [OpenAPI 3.1 Spec](https://api.claw-net.org/v1/openapi.json): SDK-ready specification
- [Endpoint Catalog](https://api.claw-net.org/v1/endpoints): Live 344+ endpoint listing with health status

## Agent Discovery

- [Agent Card](https://api.claw-net.org/.well-known/agent-card.json): Identity, capabilities, trust signals
- [A2A Agent Card](https://api.claw-net.org/.well-known/agent.json): Google Agent-to-Agent protocol (v0.3.0)
- [Agents Directory](https://api.claw-net.org/.well-known/agents.json): Service listing
- [MCP Server](https://api.claw-net.org/.well-known/mcp.json): Model Context Protocol tools
- [x402 Discovery](https://api.claw-net.org/.well-known/x402.json): x402 payment capabilities
- [DID Document](https://api.claw-net.org/.well-known/did.json): W3C DID (did:web:api.claw-net.org)
- [ERC-8004 Card](https://api.claw-net.org/.well-known/erc8004.json): Platform agent card

## Core Endpoints

- POST https://api.claw-net.org/v1/orchestrate — natural language query -> multi-step execution
- GET https://api.claw-net.org/v1/estimate — pre-flight cost estimate (no auth)
- POST https://api.claw-net.org/v1/batch — parallel multi-query (up to 10)
- GET https://api.claw-net.org/v1/stream/orchestrate — streaming via SSE
- POST https://api.claw-net.org/v1/llm/prompt — direct LLM prompting

## Skill Marketplace

- GET https://api.claw-net.org/v1/marketplace/skills — browse skills
- POST https://api.claw-net.org/v1/skills/:id/invoke — invoke a skill
- POST https://api.claw-net.org/v1/skills/:id/query — query data skills
- GET https://api.claw-net.org/v1/skills/:id/mcp — MCP tool manifest per skill
- GET https://api.claw-net.org/v1/skills/:id/openapi — OpenAPI spec per skill

## x402 Payment (no API key needed)

Pay-per-call via USDC micropayments. Wallet is the only credential.

- GET https://api.claw-net.org/x402 — discovery
- GET https://api.claw-net.org/x402/skills — browse skills with USDC pricing
- POST https://api.claw-net.org/x402/skills/:id — invoke via x402
- GET https://api.claw-net.org/x402/verify/:requestId — receipt verification

## Authentication

Three methods:
- API Key: `X-API-Key: cn-...` — most /v1/* routes
- x402: wallet-based, no key needed — /x402/* routes
- Clerk JWT: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` — user endpoints

## Pricing

- 1 credit = $0.001 (1000 credits per $1)
- Volume discounts: $5->5K, $20->22K, $50->60K, $100->125K, $500->750K, $1000->2M
- USDC: +7% bonus over card at each tier
- Cache hits: 10% of live cost (min 0.1 credits)
- Orchestration fee: 2 credits per LLM-routed query

For structured agent onboarding: https://api.claw-net.org/v1/skill.md
